name: Stockholm Archipelago in a day
description_md:
The Stockholm Archipelago in a day is a waymarked hiking route located in Sweden. This trail covers a distance of 12.2 km and requires about 6.8 hours of walking time based on the DIN 33466 hiking time rule.

The route is situated within the country of Sweden. It is a waymarked hiking route that spans 12.2 km. The estimated duration for this walk is 6.8 hours according to the DIN 33466 hiking time rule.
